title: A release can skip the closed or open test on Play while the release run still shows green
what: After a version tag, the release run puts the build on Play's internal, closed and open (public beta) tests for the phone and the watch. When Play refuses the closed or open test, or the open test is not set up, that test is skipped with only a yellow warning inside the run, and the run ends green. A missing What's new for the version also only warns and uses stand-in notes. No summary says which tests got the build, and nothing is emailed. The owner believes the beta testers got the new version when they did not.
expected: The run ends with a short list of which Play tests got the build and which were skipped and why, and a skipped closed or open test is flagged where the owner sees it (a red mark or a note), not only in the run log.
how_often: every release where Play refuses a test track
fix_line: End the Play step with a written list of tracks reached and skipped, and make a skipped beta or closed test visible

title: The reminder to renew the logs key can silently never come
what: The 10-minute check is meant to open a reminder 30 days before the logs key ends. It stays quiet with no word to anyone when the end date was never saved or was typed wrong, when HQ's status page cannot be read or answers with an error (HQ then reports no end date), or when making the reminder fails (only a line in the cloud log, the run stays green). If the key then ends, direct looks at gym data stop being recorded, and the first sign is a later outage note.
expected: When the record is on but no end date can be read, or the reminder step fails, the check says so once (a note or a red run), so a missing reminder is never mistaken for 'nothing due'.
how_often: rare, once a year at key renewal
fix_line: Treat 'record on but no end date' and a failed reminder step as something to report, not as nothing due
